rule_v2: HAM delta macro-F1 > 0 on s43 AND s44; mean >= +0.010; mel->NV mean delta <= +1.0 pp
multiplicity: 6 confirmatory tests (3 treatments x 2 encoders) on s43/s44; 5 of 6 pass the rule. Post-hoc hypotheses from s42; SoG and geom-pad declared negatives; exploratory list in phase-b-diagnostics-multiplicity-addendum.json
caveats: T1 and T3 apply DullRazor to HAM only; PAD unchanged by construction. On seed 42, DullRazor lowered PAD macro-F1 by about 0.03 (both encoders); a pipeline applying it to PAD would not be supported.
mel n=169 in HAM dev: one image is about 0.59 pp; the mel->NV tolerance of 1.0 pp is about 1.7 images. Paired CI reported separately by statistical review.
Two encoder seeds per arm; seed 42 excluded from the rule.
Effects are HAM dermoscopy-only; no clinical-photo validation.
exploratory_seed42_summary: SoG negative both encoders (HAM -0.014/-0.017); geom-pad neutral; DullRazor and crop positive on HAM, PAD negative for DullRazor
